topic: shoot in manual mode for the first time
core_question: How do I shoot photos in manual mode? (secondary: How do I reduce the file size of a PowerPoint presentation full of pictures?)
answer_summary: Switch the mode dial to M, then set aperture for depth of field, shutter speed for motion/light, and ISO for sensitivity, watching the in-viewfinder light meter and adjusting until it reads near zero.; after the topic shift: Select a picture, go to Picture Format > Compress Pictures, choose a lower resolution and apply to all images to shrink the file.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; writing in full careful sentences
